title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of How to Handle Cases Where the Person Subjected to Enforcement Has Been Dissolved in the Application for Enforcement of Legal Documents of Industrial and Commercial Arbitration Institutions

articles.content_en: 1. Where a party applies to the People's Court for enforcement of an award or mediation agreement of an industrial and commercial arbitration institution in accordance with Articles 167 and 169 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), and the People's Court discovers, upon accepting the application, that the person against whom enforcement is sought has been dissolved, the People's Court shall not accept the application. It shall inform the applicant that the applicant may apply to the original arbitration institution for a change of the person bearing the obligation, and after such change, may apply to the People's Court for enforcement.

2. Where, in the course of enforcing an award or mediation agreement of an industrial and commercial arbitration institution, the People's Court discovers that the person subject to enforcement has been dissolved, it shall issue a ruling to suspend enforcement and inform the applicant to apply to the original arbitration institution for a change of the person bearing the obligation. If the arbitration institution changes the person bearing the obligation according to law, the applicant may apply to the People's Court for resumption of enforcement.
November 14, 1990
